appraisal_type: Independent primary-source appraisal, not native record_review assessment or gate receipt

source.title: Convergent evolution of oxidized sugar metabolism in commensal and pathogenic microbes in the inflamed gut

scope: Canonical E. coli D-galactarate degradation I; optional transport/utilization context; source limitations retained.

strongest_claims.candidate_role: optional GarP-dependent galactarate-utilization/availability context; not core reaction-list membership
strongest_claims.assertion: Deletion of garP attenuated the galactarate fermentation phenotype; ectopic expression of the native BW25113 garP restored the phenotype. This supports a contribution of GarP to galactarate utilization in the tested genetic context, consistent with transport, but does not directly measure galactarate uptake or proton coupling.
strongest_claims.directness: genetic perturbation and native-gene rescue; transport mechanism inferred

strongest_claims.candidate_role: independent physiological corroboration for GarL participation, not exact catalytic equation
strongest_claims.assertion: The garL deletion strain had a markedly diminished galactarate fermentation signal and its native-gene plasmid complement restored the signal. The paper describes the loss as abolished fermentation. The endpoint supports GarL participation in utilization, not direct identification of 5-keto-4-deoxy-D-glucarate cleavage products.

strongest_claims.candidate_role: independent physiological corroboration for GarR participation, not NADH/NADPH specificity
strongest_claims.assertion: Deletion of garR attenuated galactarate fermentation and native-gene expression restored the signal in the tested Keio background. This does not determine the reductant specificity, substrate protonation, reaction stoichiometry, or protein oligomeric state.

The authors observed E. coli 5α growth in galactarate-supplemented minimal BHI under anaerobic conditions. The experiment supports utilization in 5α, not a MG1655-specific experimental claim and not growth on chemically defined galactarate as the only carbon-containing material.

Introduction and Figure1A describe GarD entry followed by GarL cleavage yielding pyruvate plus tartronate semialdehyde, GarR reduction to glycerate, and GarK phosphorylation to 2-phosphoglycerate. These are literature-derived background in this paper, not new direct characterization of those four reactions.

shared_GarP_GarL_GarR_context.mutant_background: E. coli BW25113 Keio single-gene deletion strains
shared_GarP_GarL_GarR_context.complement: BW25113 native gene PCR insert in pCW-lic, tac promoter, IPTG induction
shared_GarP_GarL_GarR_context.endpoint: A460 minus A620 after 48 h; pH indicator fermentation assay, not direct transport rate or purified-enzyme activity
shared_GarP_GarL_GarR_context.conditions: 10 g/L peptone plus 10 g/L galactarate; initial pH7.6; 100 µM IPTG; 25°C; Breathe Easy membrane; transformed overnight cultures and assay medium included 100 µg/mL carbenicillin. Fermentation atmosphere is not expressly stated as anaerobic.
shared_GarP_GarL_GarR_context.comparator: Figure3 caption and Supplementary Figure2 name BL21 positive control, not isogenic BW25113 wild type; knockout and its native-gene rescue share the Keio background.

quantification_notes.limit: n=9 numerical observations for each Figure3B group in workbook; biological independence not independently established. Do not generalize to MG1655, 5α, or every E. coli strain.
Caption says n=9; workbook has 6 observations each for deletion/native-rescue/Clos-gudL-rescue, and 9 each for blank/WT. Avoid repeating uniform n or exact significance as independently validated.

Caption says n=9 and has an apparent ΔgarP::Clos-garR typo. Workbook and figure labels identify ΔgarR::Clos-garR; 10 observations each for deletion and both rescues, 9 for blank/WT. Do not copy caption typo.

omissions.reason: GarD/GarK chemistry is background, GarL/R experiments are phenotypes; no direct enzyme stoichiometry, oligomerization or NADH/NADPH specificity; Figure1A TSA has carboxyl groups at both ends.
Cross-substrate galactarate import is a hypothesis in the Discussion, not measured uptake.
GarABC/GudL and alternative GarR constructs are heterologous rescue systems; they do not become native E. coli members. GudL direct aldolase chemistry was not demonstrated.
GarK omission from gene-discovery minimum was based on polyphyly and does not remove canonical GarK or change its2PG product.

No direct CdaR binding/activation experiment; transcript coverage precluded evaluation of changing transcriptional regulation. Abundance associations do not establish causal disease or complete routes in every taxon.

issuing_identity.limit: Identity bridge only; no untested equation or exact construct-sequence equivalence is implied. Current transport annotation is qualified probable and ECO:0000305.
